{{Quote|I saw my father give it to a pilot who had been badly burned in a chemical explosion. His friends brought him here, but by the time they arrived he had been driven mad with pain. The senflax took the pain away while leaving the pilot still able to answer questions about what chemicals he had been transporting so that my father would best know how to treat him.|Serra, on the pilot and the effects of senflax|<ref name="DoE" />}}
At some point between [[1008 BBY]] and [[992 BBY]],<ref name="Dating">According to ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', [[Serra]] was eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old during [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] first visit to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], an event depicted in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Jedi vs. Sith 1|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 1]], which is set in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. This places Serra's birth at [[1008 BBY]]. ''Dynasty of Evil'' also states that Serra left her home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] at the age of sixteen, or in [[992 BBY]]. Since Serra was still on Ambria when the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was taken to [[Caleb]], this event can be placed between those two dates.</ref> a '''pilot''' was [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] a shipment of chemicals when his cargo exploded. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] received severe burns, and the resulting pain drove him mad. The pilot's friends took him to [[Caleb]], a healer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. There, Caleb injected the pilot with [[senflax]], a [[Poison/Legends|neurotoxin]] that disrupted the nerves of the primary muscles, paralyzing them, but still allowing the patient to [[Language/Legends|talk]]. After the toxin eased his pain, the pilot was able to tell Caleb about the chemicals he had been transporting, allowing the healer to administer proper treatment. Caleb's daughter was also present during the event, and she took notice of the effects of senflax. The girl went on to become [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of the planet [[Doan]], and she used senflax to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]<ref name="DoE" /> in [[980 BBY]].<ref name="980date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' to [[980 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This pilot was briefly mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]''.<ref name="DoE" />
